summary: Tested Cygnus Rift backend and frontend via the public URL. Backend pytest: 8/16 passed; failures identify authorization, validation, and auth-security defects. Frontend core flows passed after data-load waits: teacher Summary with no Recent Bookings, dark/light persistence, Sessions filters/sort/views, section quizzes, both library modals, 40-minute cap, Groups tabs/form controls, teacher booking sorting/action states, profile/notification persistence, student role nav and Join/Leave, bad-login feedback, register tabs, and forgot-password 3-step rendering.

critical.issue: Mutation endpoints lack require_teacher; authenticated students can update/delete teacher-owned lessons, groups, and bookings.
CORS responds Access-Control-Allow-Origin: * for an untrusted origin while credentialed auth is enabled; backend CORS_ORIGINS is wildcard instead of explicit frontend origins.
No brute-force protection: six consecutive bad passwords all return 401; expected lockout after five failures.
Unknown group IDs are accepted, creating bookings with group=null and zero participants instead of 404.
The required minimum group size is not enforced; a one-student group is accepted.

minor.issue: Archived bookings can be joined through the API even though the UI disables the action.
Requested student credential student_1@test.io/password123 returns 401. The credentials file and seeded account instead use student@cygnusrift.io.

integration_issues.issue: Frontend hides teacher routes from students, but the corresponding backend mutation APIs do not enforce teacher authorization, so route hiding is bypassable.

issues: Recharts repeatedly logs width(-1)/height(-1) during initial render; the chart subsequently renders.

action_items: Add require_teacher to every teacher mutation endpoint, especially lesson/group/booking PUT and DELETE.
Use explicit CORS frontend origins with allow_credentials=True; do not return wildcard origin.
Implement Mongo-backed five-failure login lockout and clear attempts after successful login.
Validate group existence on booking create/update and reject missing linked resources.
Enforce at least eight students when creating/updating a group.
Reject joining archived bookings and validate booking existence before join/leave.
Reconcile the requested student_1@test.io credential with the seeded/documented student@cygnusrift.io account.
Add API error handling/loading states to list pages and library modal to prevent silent empty states during delayed or failed requests.
critical_code_review_comments: server.py is 758 lines and should be split into auth, lessons, groups, bookings, dashboard, models, and seed modules.
Read/list endpoints for lessons, groups, bookings, students, content blocks, and dashboard are public; confirm whether authenticated access was intended.
DELETE endpoints always return success for missing IDs, reducing API correctness and observability.
LibraryPickerModal and list pages use promise chains without catch/loading states; a slow request temporarily displays zero results or an empty page.
JWT access tokens live for seven days and are duplicated into localStorage, increasing XSS exposure relative to cookie-only short-lived access plus refresh tokens.
Most table-view action buttons, modal close/cancel controls, form back/cancel controls, and generated quiz option inputs still lack data-testid attributes.

success_rate.frontend: 92% of executed flows; core requested UI paths passed, with backend security/validation defects exposed

seed_data_creation: Created temporary TEST auth/resource data during API tests and cleaned it. Profile phone/notification and student Join/Leave state were restored. Removed the teacher password-reset record generated during the non-destructive 3-step UI check.
context_for_next_testing_agent: Run pytest /app/backend/tests/backend_test.py with the public URL. Existing failures are expected until server authorization, CORS, lockout, group-size, booking-link, and archived-join fixes land. For UI async lists/modals, wait for the first data-testid row/block instead of asserting immediately. Theme preference was restored to dark.
rca_of_the_issue: server.py applies require_teacher only to lesson/group/booking creation and add-student, not update/delete operations. GroupIn has no minimum-size validator. create_booking checks lesson but not group. join_booking blindly adds an email without checking booking status/existence. Login has no attempt store/lockout. CORS reads CORS_ORIGINS='*' while credentials are enabled. The requested student_1@test.io account is not seeded; the actual seed and credentials file use student@cygnusrift.io.
